answer: An exchange trading pigment, willow timber and onyx could bind every earning key to an exclusive licensed radio time slot. Validators check the regulator's signed lease, record its serial once per epoch and reject another key claiming the same slot. Extra aliases, including parallel colluders, must lease additional slots; recurring lease costs must exceed the capped extra reward. This trusts an honest registry, enforceable exclusivity and the reward cap; sham leases break it. Short, small-area leases offer newcomers a cheaper entry.
